summary: myidsan's federated login gains a provider-registry seam (infra/login.Registry, infra/login.RedirectProvider) so identity providers beyond Google/GitHub (LDAP/AD, Kerberos SPNEGO, OIDC - see docs/MYIDSAN_ENTERPRISE_SSO_PLAN.md) can be added without touching routing again. The four hardcoded Google/GitHub routes are replaced by one generic pair, GET /api/login/{provider} and GET /api/callback/{provider}, driven by the registry that NewLoginApi builds and returns; NewFederatedAuthApi and the SPA's provider buttons now read the same registry instead of hardcoded config checks. GET /api/login/providers gains an authoritative list:[{key,displayName}] field alongside the legacy {google,github} booleans. Account resolution for every federated login now goes through one new services.UpsertFederated, which matches strictly on (provider, subject) rather than email - fixing a real account-takeover risk where the old per-provider Google/GitHub callback code merged federated logins onto any existing account with a matching email, letting a same-email account registered at a different provider silently take it over. A same-email account with no identity bound yet may still claim one, once; a bound conflict is refused (ErrFederatedIdentityConflict); a full miss creates a new pending-clearance account (role 0), matching every other new-user path in the suite. domain/entities.UserLogin gains SsoProvider/SsoSubject columns (auto-migrated by bootstrap).
compatibility: Backward compatible for existing deployments: Google/GitHub still register the same way (client_id/client_secret both non-empty), routes resolve to the same URLs, and the SPA's legacy {google,github} boolean fields are preserved in the providers response for older frontend builds. Existing local and federated accounts are unaffected; a pre-upgrade social user (email-matched, no SsoProvider/SsoSubject set yet) transparently claims its identity binding on its next federated login. New columns default to empty strings via the bootstrap migration - no manual DB step required.
